description: Look up a tariff code, description, lineage and general rate. Paid deep adds statistical units and the special and other schedule columns. Optional origin with deep resolves country-specific measures. Without origin, schedule detail is available and origin-dependent fields are null. A null effective rate is not a zero rate.

code.description: HTS code, 4 to 10 digits, dots optional, e.g. 8471.30.01.00

deep.description: Include the nested deep object when available. Pricing depends on the operation.

origin.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country of origin for duty resolution, only read with deep, e.g. US

name: tariff
title: Tariff
